purpose: Route founders to the correct university-side partner for STTR collaboration, IP licensing, spinout formation, proof-of-concept funding, and federal R&D commercialization.
important_caveat: These are university commercialization and research-partner contacts, not federal grant officers. Nucleus Grow remains the primary Utah SBIR/STTR proposal-support route.
